statusText.COMPLETED: Everything found within the limit was searched.
statusText.PARTIAL: Some pages could not be searched (total time, blocks or errors): the results cover only what was searched.
statusText.BLOCKED: The site blocked the visit. EXEGEZIS does not try to get past the block.
statusText.UNREACHABLE: The site could not be reached (DNS, TLS or connection).
statusText.TIMEOUT: The entry page did not finish loading in time.
statusText.ENGINE_ERROR: The browser could not start on this computer. The problem is on this computer, not on the site.
statusText.COST_LIMIT: The meaning part did not run (or stopped) because its cost exceeded the limit.
statusText.AI_ERROR: The meaning part failed. The exact part, if any, was searched.

verdictHelp.VERIFIED: It appears in every load of the page.
verdictHelp.INTERMITTENT: It appears only in some loads (carousel, random content…).
verdictHelp.SUGGESTED_QUOTE_VERIFIED: The quote is real (it is literally on the page); whether it is relevant is up to you.

hit.label: Result: {text}
hit.shotAlt: Screenshot of the page with the block marked
hit.variantTitle: Found because it has the same stem as the term (variants on)
hit.loadsTitle: Loads of the page in clean contexts in which it appeared
hit.hiddenShot: Text not visible: it does not appear in the screenshot

list.title: Searches
list.description: Searches in a site's text: exact (no AI, verified in every load) or by meaning (the AI suggests and every quote is checked letter by letter on the page).
list.noneBody: Start one from the home page (Search tab), or with <command></command>.
list.line: {hits, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} · {searched} of {found} pages searched · {when}
list.savedSubtitle: repeat them with one click and see what is new
list.noSaved: None. Save a search from its detail page, or when starting it (advanced options).

detail.invalidBody: The report does not meet its schema, or its results, verdicts, quotes or coverage do not derive from what was recorded (for example, a quote that is not in the page text). It is not shown, not even in part.
detail.noBrowser: No browser could start on this computer, so no page was visited: nothing was searched on {origin}.
detail.searched: Searched {searched} of {found, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} found.
detail.budget: at most {pages} pages, depth {depth}, {runs, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} per page
detail.skippedSafety: {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}} skipped for safety (sign out, delete…)
detail.includesHidden: includes text that is not visible (marked)
detail.noHidden: no text that is not visible
detail.summary: {hits, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} on {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}: {verified} verified, {intermittent} intermittent
detail.summarySuggested: , {count, plural, one {# suggestion} other {# suggestions}} with a verified quote
detail.summaryHidden: · {count} in text that is not visible
detail.excluded: Excluded by “{term}” ({scope, select, block {only the block} other {whole page}}): {hits, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} in {blocks, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}} of {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}.
detail.variantsNote: With variants (Snowball stem): every result by variant says which stem matched it. It can join different words (house/housing).
detail.wouldCost: It would cost up to {estimate} and the limit is {limit}. Nothing was sent to the AI.
detail.approveHelp: The pages already read are reused: the site is not visited again. The default limit is changed in Settings → Searches.
detail.aiLine: {model} · {calls, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} · {input} input tokens, {output} output · {seconds} s
detail.aiCost: Cost: {cost} (estimated before: up to {estimate}; limit {limit}) · prompt {prompt}
detail.aiPages: {count, plural, one {# page sent} other {# pages sent}}
detail.aiRedactions: · {count} blocks with personal data or secrets redacted before sending
detail.discarded: {count, plural, one {# AI quote discarded: it did not appear literally on the page. It is not shown.} other {# AI quotes discarded: they did not appear literally on the page. They are not shown.}}
detail.aiCaveat: Meaning search may not find everything (false negatives). Its results are suggestions with a verified quote, never “verified”.
detail.filterPlaceholder: Filter by text, page or term
detail.comparison: Compared with the previous run of this saved search (<link></link>): {new, plural, one {# new} other {# new}}, {gone} no longer {gone, plural, one {appears} other {appear}}.
detail.noMatches: 0 matches in {count, plural, one {# page searched} other {# pages searched}}
detail.noneSearched: No page could be searched: see the status and coverage above.
detail.noMatchesBody: {searched} of {found} pages found were searched{skipped, plural, =0 {} other {; # were beyond the limit}}. No matches here does not mean there are none on the rest of the site.
detail.isSaved: It is a saved search: repeat it from <link>Saved searches</link> and you will see what is new.
detail.name: Name
